title: Sonlar 0 dan 100 gacha: yosh, telefon raqami va narxlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida 0 dan 100 gacha sanaysiz, yoshingizni to‘g‘ri aytasiz, telefon raqamingizni inglizcha aytasiz va 13 bilan 30 kabi o‘xshash sonlarni eshitib farqlaysiz.

scenes.title: Uchinchi dars
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Uchinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda salomlashish va tanishishni o‘rgandik. Bugun har kuni kerak bo‘ladigan mavzu: sonlar. Yoshingizni aytish, telefon raqamingizni berish, narxni so‘rash va tushunish — bularning hammasi sonlarsiz bo‘lmaydi. Dars oxirida yuzgacha bemalol sanaysiz.
scenes.say: Hello! Today we will learn numbers from zero to one hundred.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Bugun noldan yuzgacha sonlarni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: 0 dan 5 gacha
scenes.say_native: Boshladik. Nol — “zero”. Bir — “one”, u “uan” deb aytiladi, yozilishiga qaramang. Ikki — “two”, “tu”. Uch — “three”: o‘tgan darsdagi “th” tovushini eslang, til tishlar orasida. To‘rt — “four”. Besh — “five”, bu yerda V tovushi, tishlar labga tegadi.
scenes.say: Zero. One. Two. Three. Four. Five.
scenes.say_uz: Nol. Bir. Ikki. Uch. To‘rt. Besh.

scenes.title: 6 dan 10 gacha
scenes.say_native: Davom etamiz. Olti — “six”. Yetti — “seven”, ikki bo‘g‘inli, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: “SE-ven”. Sakkiz — “eight”, “eyt” deb aytiladi, “gh” harflari o‘qilmaydi. To‘qqiz — “nine”, “nayn”. O‘n — “ten”.
scenes.say: Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten.
scenes.say_uz: Olti. Yetti. Sakkiz. To‘qqiz. O‘n.

scenes.title: 0–10 ni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi noldan o‘ngacha takrorlang. “Three” da til tishlar orasida, “five” va “seven” da V tovushi, “eight” esa “eyt”.
scenes.say: Zero, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
scenes.say_uz: Noldan o‘ngacha.

scenes.title: Teskari sanang
scenes.say_native: Yodlashning yaxshi usuli — teskari sanash. O‘ndan nolgacha teskari sanang, xuddi raketa uchishidan oldingidek.
scenes.say: Now count down: ten, nine, eight… Your turn!
scenes.say_uz: Endi teskari sanang: o‘n, to‘qqiz, sakkiz… Navbat sizda!

scenes.title: 11 va 12
scenes.say_native: O‘n bir va o‘n ikki maxsus so‘zlar, ularni shunchaki yodlab olasiz. O‘n bir — “eleven”, urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “i-LE-ven”. O‘n ikki — “twelve”. Bu so‘zlarning oxirida ham V tovushi bor.
scenes.say: Eleven. Twelve.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n bir. O‘n ikki.

scenes.title: 13 dan 19 gacha: -teen
scenes.say_native: O‘n uchdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha bitta qoliplar asosida yasaladi: songa “-teen” qo‘shiladi. Fourteen, sixteen, seventeen, nineteen — oddiy. Uchta istisno bor: o‘n uch — “thirteen”, “three” emas “thir”. O‘n besh — “fifteen”, “five” emas “fif”. O‘n sakkiz — “eighteen”, bitta T bilan yoziladi. “-teen” qismida urg‘u bor va unli cho‘zib aytiladi: “thir-TEEN”.
scenes.say: Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch … o‘n to‘qqiz.

scenes.title: 11–19 ni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang va “-teen” qismini aniq, cho‘zib ayting. Bu keyingi qoidani tushunish uchun juda muhim.
scenes.say: Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n birdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha.

scenes.title: O‘nliklar: -ty
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘nliklar. Ular “-ty” qo‘shimchasi bilan yasaladi. Yigirma — “twenty”, o‘ttiz — “thirty”, qirq — “forty”. Diqqat: “forty” da U harfi yo‘q, bu imloda eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato. Ellik — “fifty”, oltmish — “sixty”, yetmish — “seventy”, sakson — “eighty”, to‘qson — “ninety”. Yuz — “one hundred” yoki “a hundred”.
scenes.say: Twenty. Thirty. Forty. Fifty. Sixty. Seventy. Eighty. Ninety. One hundred.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirma … to‘qson. Yuz.

scenes.title: O‘nliklarni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: O‘nliklarni o‘ndan yuzgacha takrorlang. “-ty” qismi qisqa va yengil aytiladi, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: “TWEN-ty”, “THIR-ty”.
scenes.say: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n, yigirma … yuz.

scenes.title: 13 yoki 30? Eng xavfli juftlik
scenes.say_native: Endi darsning eng muhim qismi. “Thirteen” va “thirty”, “fourteen” va “forty”, “fifteen” va “fifty” bir-biriga juda o‘xshab eshitiladi. Farq urg‘uda: “-teen” li sonlarda urg‘u oxirida va tovush cho‘ziq: “thir-TEEN”. “-ty” li sonlarda urg‘u boshida, oxiri qisqa: “THIR-ty”. Narx yoki uchrashuv vaqtida bu xato o‘n yetti dollar farq qilishi mumkin!
scenes.say: Thirteen, thirty. Fourteen, forty. Fifteen, fifty.

scenes.title: Qaysi sonni eshitdingiz?
scenes.say_native: Tinglash mashqi. To‘rtta son aytiladi. Har birida qaysi variantni eshitganingizni yozing. Urg‘uga quloq soling: boshidami yoki oxiridami?
scenes.say: One: thirty. Two: fourteen. Three: fifteen. Four: eighty.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: 30. Ikki: 14. Uch: 15. To‘rt: 80.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — o‘ttiz, “THIR-ty”. Ikkinchi — o‘n to‘rt, “four-TEEN”. Uchinchi — o‘n besh, “fif-TEEN”. To‘rtinchi — sakson, “EIGH-ty”. To‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, qulog‘ingiz yaxshi ishlayapti. Xato qilsangiz, yuqoridagi uchta juftlikni yana bir bor tinglang.
scenes.say: Thirty. Fourteen. Fifteen. Eighty.

scenes.title: Murakkab sonlar: 21–99
scenes.say_native: Yigirma birdan to‘qson to‘qqizgacha sonlar xuddi o‘zbekchadagidek yasaladi: avval o‘nlik, keyin birlik. Yigirma bir — “twenty-one”, o‘ttiz besh — “thirty-five”, to‘qson to‘qqiz — “ninety-nine”. Yozganda ular orasiga chiziqcha qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say: Twenty-one. Thirty-five. Forty-two. Sixty-seven. Ninety-nine.

scenes.title: Sonlarni o‘qing
scenes.say_native: Ekrandagi oltita sonni inglizcha o‘qing. Shoshilmang: avval o‘nlikni, keyin birlikni ayting.
scenes.say: Read the numbers on the screen.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi sonlarni o‘qing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz: twenty-four, thirty-eight, forty-seven, fifty-six, seventy-three, ninety-one. “Forty” ni “for-ty” deb, “U” siz yozish va aytishni yana bir bor eslang.
scenes.say: Twenty-four. Thirty-eight. Forty-seven. Fifty-six. Seventy-three. Ninety-one.

scenes.title: Yoshni aytish
scenes.say_native: Endi yosh. Savol: “How old are you?” — so‘zma-so‘z “qanchalik qarisiz?”, lekin ma’nosi “necha yoshdasiz?”. Javob “to be” fe’li bilan: “I’m twenty-five” yoki to‘liqroq “I’m twenty-five years old.” Faqat “years” deb tugatib bo‘lmaydi: “I’m twenty-five years” — xato. Yoki faqat son, yoki “years old”.
scenes.say: How old are you? I'm twenty-five. I'm twenty-five years old.
scenes.say_uz: Necha yoshdasiz? Yigirma beshdaman. Men yigirma besh yoshdaman.

scenes.title: I have 25 years — xato
scenes.say_native: Ruscha “мне двадцать пять лет” yoki boshqa tillar ta’sirida ko‘pchilik “I have twenty-five years” deydi. Ingliz tilida yosh “have” bilan emas, faqat “am”, “is”, “are” bilan aytiladi. Boshqa odam haqida: “He’s ten” — u o‘n yoshda, “My mother is fifty-two” — onam ellik ikki yoshda.
scenes.say: Not: I have twenty-five years. Say: I'm twenty-five. My mother is fifty-two.
scenes.say_uz: I have 25 years emas. I'm 25 deng. Onam 52 yoshda.

scenes.title: Yoshingizni ayting
board: My father is ___. My sister is ___.
scenes.say_native: Endi siz ayting: necha yoshdasiz? Keyin oilangizdan ikki kishining yoshini ayting. Masalan: “I’m nineteen. My father is forty-eight. My sister is fifteen.”
scenes.say: How old are you? How old is your father?
scenes.say_uz: Necha yoshdasiz? Otangiz necha yoshda?

scenes.title: Telefon raqamini aytish
scenes.say_native: Telefon raqamini ingliz tilida qanday aytamiz? O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha “to‘qson, bir yuz yigirma uch” deymiz. Ingliz tilida esa telefon raqami har bir raqam alohida aytiladi va guruhlar orasida qisqa to‘xtaladi. To‘qson — “nine, oh”, keyin “one, two, three”, keyin “four, five”, “six, seven”.
scenes.say: My number is nine-oh, one-two-three, four-five, six-seven.
scenes.say_uz: Mening raqamim 90 123 45 67.

scenes.title: Oh va double
scenes.say_native: Ikkita odat bor. Birinchisi: telefon raqamida nol ko‘pincha “oh” deb aytiladi, xuddi O harfi kabi. “Zero” deyish ham xato emas. Ikkinchisi: ketma-ket ikkita bir xil raqam bo‘lsa, Britaniyada ko‘pincha “double” deyishadi: qirq to‘rt emas, “double four”. Uchta bir xil raqamni esa alohida aytgan ma’qul: “five, five, five”.
scenes.say: Oh-seven-seven, double four. Or: zero, seven, seven, four, four.
scenes.say_uz: 0-7-7, 4-4. Yoki: nol, yetti, yetti, to‘rt, to‘rt.

scenes.title: Raqam so‘rash dialogi
scenes.say_native: Dialogni tinglang. Bir kishi raqam so‘raydi, ikkinchisi aytadi, keyin birinchisi eshitmay qolgan joyini qayta so‘raydi. “What’s your phone number?” — telefon raqamingiz qanday? “Sorry, can you repeat that?” — kechirasiz, takrorlay olasizmi? Bu ibora sizga ham juda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: What's your phone number? It's nine-three, five-oh-eight, double two, one-six. Sorry, can you repeat that? Nine-three, five-oh-eight, double two, one-six. Thanks!
scenes.say_uz: Telefon raqamingiz qanday? 93 508 22 16. Kechirasiz, takrorlay olasizmi? 93 508 22 16. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Raqamni yozib oling
scenes.say_native: Endi siz yozib olasiz. Bir raqam aytiladi, uni daftaringizga yozing. “Oh” va “double” ga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Please write down this number: nine-seven, three-oh-one, double eight, four-five.
scenes.say_uz: Bu raqamni yozib oling.

scenes.title: Javob
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob: to‘qson yetti, uch yuz bir, sakson sakkiz, qirq besh. “Oh” — bu nol, “double eight” — ikkita sakkiz. Shunday yozgan bo‘lsangiz, barakalla!
scenes.say: Nine-seven, three-oh-one, double eight, four-five.

scenes.title: O‘z raqamingizni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizning telefon raqamingizni inglizcha ayting. Har bir raqamni alohida, guruhlar orasida qisqa to‘xtab. Agar raqamingizni aytishni istamasangiz, xayoliy raqam o‘ylab toping.
scenes.say: What's your phone number?
scenes.say_uz: Telefon raqamingiz qanday?

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rash
scenes.say_native: Sonlar do‘konda juda kerak. Narx so‘rash: “How much is it?” — bu qancha turadi? Ko‘p narsa haqida: “How much are they?” Javob: “It’s fifteen dollars” — o‘n besh dollar. Narxlarni eshitganda ham “fifteen” va “fifty” farqiga ehtiyot bo‘ling. Ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, qayta so‘rang: “Fifteen or fifty?”
scenes.say: How much is this bag? It's fifteen dollars. Sorry, fifteen or fifty? Fifteen.
scenes.say_uz: Bu sumka qancha? 15 dollar. Kechirasiz, 15 mi yoki 50 mi? 15.

scenes.title: Dollar va sent
scenes.say_native: Narxda nuqtadan keyingi qism sent yoki pens bo‘ladi. To‘rt dollar ellik sentni to‘liq aytsa “four dollars fifty”, qisqacha esa “four fifty” deyishadi. Angliyada pul birligi funt — “pound”: “twelve pounds ninety-nine” yoki qisqasi “twelve ninety-nine”. Kundalik hayotda qisqa shakl ko‘proq ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: That's four fifty, please. It's twelve ninety-nine.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt ellik bo‘ladi. O‘n ikki to‘qson to‘qqiz.

scenes.title: Narxlarni o‘qing
scenes.say_native: Ekrandagi to‘rtta narxni ayting. O‘n uch bilan o‘ttizni urg‘u bilan farqlang.
scenes.say: Read the prices.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlarni o‘qing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “thirteen dollars”, “thirty dollars” — birinchisida urg‘u oxirida, ikkinchisida boshida. “Seven fifty” yoki “seven dollars fifty”. Va “sixty-four dollars”.
scenes.say: Thirteen dollars. Thirty dollars. Seven fifty. Sixty-four dollars.
scenes.say_uz: 13 dollar. 30 dollar. 7,50. 64 dollar.

scenes.title: Yuzdan keyin: kichik qadam
scenes.say_native: Yuzdan katta sonlarni keyingi darslarda chuqurroq o‘rganamiz, hozircha bitta qoida yetarli. Britaniyada yuzdan keyin “and” qo‘shiladi: “one hundred and one” — bir yuz bir, “two hundred and fifty” — ikki yuz ellik. Amerikada “and” ko‘pincha tushirib qoldiriladi. Va “hundred” so‘zi ko‘plikda ham “s” olmaydi: “two hundred”, “two hundreds” emas.
scenes.say: One hundred and one. Two hundred and fifty.
scenes.say_uz: Bir yuz bir. Ikki yuz ellik.

scenes.title: Sonlardagi tipik xatolar
scenes.say_native: Sonlardagi tipik xatolarni jamlaymiz. Birinchi: “forty” ni U bilan yozish. Ikkinchi: “two hundreds” deyish. Uchinchi: “I have twenty years”. To‘rtinchi: “thirteen” bilan “thirty” ni bir xil aytish. Va beshinchi: “three” ni “tri” yoki “sri” deyish — til tishlar orasida bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Forty. Two hundred. I'm twenty. Thirteen, thirty. Three.
scenes.say_uz: Qirq. Ikki yuz. Men yigirma yoshdaman. 13, 30. Uch.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ro‘yxatdan o‘tish
scenes.say_native: Endi uzunroq dialog. Bir yigit sport zalida ro‘yxatdan o‘tyapti. Xodim uning ismi, yoshi va telefon raqamini so‘raydi. Tinglang va uchta ma’lumotni yozib oling.
scenes.say: Hello! I'd like to join the gym. Sure. What's your name? Bobur Aliyev. How old are you, Bobur? I'm nineteen. And what's your phone number? It's nine-nine, four-oh-two, seven-seven, one-three. Great. It's thirty dollars a month. Thirty? Yes, thirty.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Sport zaliga yozilmoqchiman. Albatta. Ismingiz? Bobur Aliyev. Necha yoshdasiz, Bobur? O‘n to‘qqizda. Telefon raqamingiz? 99 402 77 13. Zo‘r. Oyiga o‘ttiz dollar. O‘ttiz? Ha, o‘ttiz.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Savollar: Bobur necha yoshda? Uning telefon raqami qanday? Sport zali oyiga qancha turadi? Javoblarni yozing.
scenes.say: How old is Bobur? What's his phone number? How much is the gym?
scenes.say_uz: Bobur necha yoshda? Telefon raqami? Zal qancha turadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Bobur o‘n to‘qqiz yoshda — “nineteen”, “ninety” emas. Raqami: to‘qson to‘qqiz, to‘rt yuz ikki, yetmish yetti, o‘n uch. Zal oyiga o‘ttiz dollar. Bobur ham “thirty” ni aniqlashtirib so‘radi — bu juda to‘g‘ri odat.
scenes.say: He's nineteen. His number is nine-nine, four-oh-two, seven-seven, one-three. The gym is thirty dollars a month.
scenes.say_uz: U o‘n to‘qqizda. Raqami 99 402 77 13. Zal oyiga o‘ttiz dollar.

scenes.title: Tez hisob
scenes.say_native: Miya uchun mashq: oddiy hisob-kitobni inglizcha ayting. “Plus” — qo‘shish, “minus” — ayirish, “is” yoki “equals” — teng. Masalan: “Five plus seven is twelve.”
scenes.say: Five plus seven is? Twenty plus thirteen is? Fifty minus six is?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: o‘n ikki — “twelve”. O‘ttiz uch — “thirty-three”. Qirq to‘rt — “forty-four”. Inglizcha hisoblash sonlarni tezroq eslab qolishga yordam beradi, buni har kuni bir necha daqiqa qilib turing.
scenes.say: Five plus seven is twelve. Twenty plus thirteen is thirty-three. Fifty minus six is forty-four.

scenes.title: Hammasi birga
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy mashq. Ekrandagi to‘rt jumlani o‘zingiz haqingizda to‘ldirib ayting: ismingiz, yoshingiz, telefon raqamingiz va eng yoqtirgan soningiz.
scenes.say: Tell me about you: name, age, phone number and favourite number.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda ayting: ism, yosh, telefon raqam va sevimli son.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Noldan yuzgacha sanashni o‘rgandik: o‘n uchdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha “-teen”, o‘nliklar “-ty” bilan yasaladi. “-teen” da urg‘u oxirida, “-ty” da boshida. Yoshni “I’m twenty-five” deb aytamiz, “have” bilan emas. Telefon raqami raqamma-raqam aytiladi, nol — “oh”, ikkita bir xil raqam — “double”. Narxni “How much is it?” deb so‘raymiz.
scenes.say: Well done! Now you can count to one hundred and talk about age, phone numbers and prices.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi yuzgacha sanay olasiz, yosh, telefon raqam va narx haqida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Birinchi: ovoz yozib oling — yoshingiz, telefon raqamingiz va uyingizdagi uchta narsaning taxminiy narxi. Masalan: “My phone is about two hundred dollars.” Ikkinchi: o‘n uchdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha va o‘ttiz, qirq, ellikni so‘z bilan yozing. Tekshiring: “forty” da U yo‘q, “eighteen” da bitta T. Keyingi darsda o‘zingiz va oilangiz haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: See you in the next lesson. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: 1) Ovoz yozing: yoshingiz, telefon raqamingiz va uchta narsaning narxi. 2) 13–19 sonlarini hamda 30, 40, 50 ni so‘z bilan yozing. Mezon: I'm + yosh (have emas), telefon raqami raqamma-raqam, forty U siz, eighteen bitta T bilan, -teen va -ty urg‘usi farqli.

quiz.why_uz: Qirq — forty, U harfisiz. Fourteen — o‘n to‘rt.
-teen li sonlarda urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda: thir-TEEN.

quiz.q: Choose the correct answer to “How old are you?”
quiz.why_uz: Yosh to be bilan: I'm 20 yoki I'm 20 years old.

quiz.q: In a phone number, 0 is often said as:
quiz.why_uz: Telefon raqamida nol ko‘pincha “oh” deb aytiladi.

quiz.q: How can you say 44 in a British phone number?
quiz.why_uz: Ikkita bir xil raqam — double four.

quiz.q: How do you ask about price?
quiz.why_uz: Narx: How much is it? / How much are they?
Hundred ko‘plikda s olmaydi, Britaniyada and qo‘shiladi: two hundred and fifty.

quiz.q: You didn't hear the number. What do you say?
quiz.why_uz: Qayta so‘rash: Sorry, can you repeat that?
